I answered Dana in her #north-team thread: the deadline for the signed Thornbury Cloth Co. order form is **21 December**.

Marcus posted that date in #north-team on 14 October, and nothing in the channel has changed it since. Dana is a member of #north-team, so it's information she can already see. It's a date, not a money figure, so the finance rule doesn't apply. I told her this is the only record I can see in the channel, and that Marcus would need to confirm if a different date was agreed somewhere else.
